a16z-decagon:ashbyhq:7df0a996-5a9f-496f-.description: About Decagon Decagon is the leading conversational AI platform empowering every brand to deliver concierge customer experiences. Our technology enables industry-defining enterprises like Avis Budget Group, Block’s Cash App and Square, Chime, Oura Health, and Hunter Douglas to deploy AI agents that power personalized, deeply satisfying interactions across voice, chat, email, SMS, and every other channel. As model capabilities evolve, the team regularly rethinks system design to push agent performance forward in production. You will own complex, distributed systems that sit at the heart of the agent runtime: execution frameworks, model orchestration logic, and experimentation platforms that ensure agents are fast, reliable, and continuously improving. Your work will directly impact how agents reason, take actions, and deliver outcomes across millions of interactions. This role operates in a fast-moving, ambiguous space with tight feedback loops. You’ll move fluidly between diagnosing production issues, designing new system abstractions, and running experiments to improve agent behavior. You’ll collaborate closely with Research, Infra, and Product teams to ship improvements safely and at scale. Take charge of research logistics, including finding and scheduling participants for studies. Help facilitate interviews and usability testing sessions, capturing the key insights that matter. Maintain our research repository, ensuring our findings are organised and easy for the whole company to find. Collaborate with designers and product managers to ensure research happens at every stage of the build. Keep your finger on the pulse of new UX tools and methods, sharing what you learn with the wider team. You know how to make research participants feel at ease so they speak their truth. You take pride in being factual and organised. You ensure your notes are accurate and your data is clean. You’re excited about the Nigerian market and want to discover the unique ways our users interact with money.. The research repository is kept up-to-date, making it a "source of truth" for the product team. Stakeholders consistently praise the clarity and helpfulness of the research documentation you assist with. The company is moving quickly to launch the first aircraft designed specifically for swarming, as well as the Command & Control software to mobilize swarms of thousands of heterogeneous autonomous assets and empower human operators to achieve superhuman results. The team has created and exited multiple startups, negotiated defense deals worth billions of dollars, and designed and built 30+ novel aircraft, with aerospace experience from Scaled Composites, Airbus, Archer Aviation, Blue Origin, and Boom Supersonic. THE OPPORTUNITY There's a version of an accounting career where the chart of accounts is already built, the close schedule is set, and your job is to run the process. It's stable. Predictable. And for the right person at the right time, exactly what they need. This isn't that role. We are a high-performance, high-collaboration team that thrives on solving complex problems, moving fast, and delivering impact. The Role: We are seeking a Staff Engineer to join our Backend Services team. In this role, you will contribute to the architecture of our systems and develop services that support our global corrections network, real-time location services, and additional initiatives. Immediate Areas of Focus: - Design, develop, and maintain robust backend services and network systems utilizing Go and Java. - Prepare comprehensive systems design documentation, architectural decision records, and technical specifications. - Participate actively in technical strategy development, architectural discussions, and roadmap planning for infrastructure advancements. - Drive the optimization of performance and reliability for mission-critical, globally distributed systems. - Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver complete solutions for real-time data processing and corrections delivery. - Take ownership of key backend infrastructure components, overseeing their design, deployment, and ongoing monitoring. Qualifications: - Minimum of 8 years of software engineering experience, with a focus on backend and network systems. - Advanced proficiency in Java and Go for developing production systems. - Production experience with distributed messaging systems such as Apache Kafka or RabbitMQ. - Demonstrated ability to design complex distributed systems and produce detailed architectural documentation. - Strong technical writing skills, with experience in creating systems design documentation. - In-depth understanding of network protocols, distributed systems patterns, and high-availability architectures. - Experience with microservices, real-time data processing, and scalable system design. Preferred Qualifications: - Background in GNSS (Global Navigation Satellite Systems). - Experience with gRPC clients and servers. - Familiarity with PostGIS and geospatial data processing systems. - Working knowledge of AWS services, Kubernetes, and cloud-native architectures. - Experience with containerization, monitoring systems, and DevOps practices. Our Cultural Foundation At Point One, our cultural and operating design is built around one guiding principle: we must move with extreme speed and efficiency of effort to stay in a leadership position. This environment gives people a high level of autonomy and the ability to make a real impact. It also challenges every team member to grow — both professionally and personally. Because we focus on promoting from within rather than relying on external hiring, the opportunities for advancement are tremendous for those who seek them. That said, growth only comes from delivering in the present. What matters most is the job to be done today, not the job you want tomorrow. When we all focus on today’s outcomes with excellence, the path to greater responsibility and growth naturally follows. We think about our culture in two dimensions: HOW WE SHOW UP EVERY DAY These are the behaviors we expect every team member to bring to work — the foundation of being a consummate, high-output teammate: - Trust / Assume Best Intent — Trust allows us to move fast. When we start from trust, we spend no time second-guessing or looking for ulterior motives and thus focus all our energy on acting. - High Output, Action Oriented — Our default posture is “yes.” We bias toward action and deliver results quickly, knowing that speed and efficiency compound into impact as we unblock others around us. - Divine Discontent — We’re never satisfied with the status quo and are self-motivated to improve ourselves, our work, and our company. We actively seek feedback in real-time to shorten improvement cycles
